= filepath_join

Joins filepath components into a single path.


== Examples

[,bloblang]
----
root.path = this.path_elements.filepath_join()

# In:  {"path_elements":["/foo/","bar.txt"]}
# Out: {"path":"/foo/bar.txt"}
----
